name: suit-businessman-portrait
image_vibe: Confident polished black tailoring with understated luxury and clean corporate studio lighting
image_purpose: Create a premium corporate headshot or menswear campaign portrait.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic studio portrait of an original adult businessman in a tailored black suit showcasing a luxury wristwatch.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult man with a well-groomed beard, a slight natural smile, and a composed confident expression. He wears a tailored black suit, black tie, and white dress shirt while adjusting his suit cuff to showcase a luxury wristwatch.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered corporate headshot-style portrait with the cuff and wristwatch visible as a secondary focal point, clean gray studio background with soft gradient, and sharp facial detail.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused key light with subtle rim lighting, natural skin modeling, restrained cinematic color grade, clean premium corporate atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on face, cuff, and watch, realistic wool, cotton, metal, skin, and beard texture, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic studio portrait of an original adult businessman with a well-groomed beard, slight natural smile, and composed confident expression. Dress him in a tailored black suit, black tie, and white dress shirt while he adjusts his suit cuff to showcase a luxury wristwatch. Use a clean gray studio background with a soft gradient, soft diffused key light, subtle rim lighting, natural skin modeling, an 85mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the face, cuff, and watch, realistic wool, cotton, metal, skin, and beard texture, restrained cinematic color grading, premium corporate editorial photography, 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed watch, unreadable branding, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source black suit businessman portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for black tailoring, beard, cuff-adjustment gesture, wristwatch, gray gradient studio, and corporate lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult male subject, black suit and tie, white shirt, beard, cuff gesture, luxury wristwatch, gray studio, and corporate portrait intent. Identity and non-essential details may vary.
